about_the_game:
You must first create your own API key in order to log in and play the game.

No choices, no scripts. Build a genuine relationship with an AI that takes the initiative to reach out to you—growing from friends to lovers, with a story path that belongs only to you.

About This Game
This is not a traditional dating sim, but a relationship simulation where your words shape the outcome. Through natural conversation, you build trust and affection. The character will actively care about you, start topics, send invitations, and remember your actions and preferences over time. Three main routes (Friendship / Romance / Special) with open branching paths mean there are no “correct answers”—only endings that are uniquely yours.

Key Features

  • Free Conversation: No fixed choices. Talk about anything you like.

  • Active Interaction: The character will reach out to you with questions and invitations.

  • Memory & Growth: The AI remembers your preferences and attitude, shaping the relationship as time passes.

  • Multiple Routes: Friendship, Romance, and Special relationship paths.

  • Instant Play: Lightweight requirements; AI functions require an online connection.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • Additional Notes: 最低解析度 1280×720；AI 功能需持續網路連線。1280×720 minimum; continuous Internet required for AI features.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • Additional Notes: 建議解析度 1920×1080。1920×1080 recommended.

short_description: You must create your own API key to play. AI relationship sim with real-time memory and emotions. Characters message you, invite you, and react to your words. Build bonds through free chat and explore three routes—Friendship, Lover, Special—with dynamic outfits and multiple endings.
